name: Barra Velha (Brazil)
description: Blue field with a broad white descending diagonal band, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in a blue-framed white panel.
history: Barra Velha is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 42 of 17 May 1972, and that the flag is also used without the blue frame around the arms or with the arms in a white rectangle with rounded corners.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a quartered shield with fish, a bridge and waves, reading BARRA VELHA
